019public class MilitaryResponseScript implements EveryFrameScript {
020        
021        public static String RESPONSE_ASSIGNMENT = "response"; // custom value added to assignments so we know which to clear
022        
023        public static class MilitaryResponseParams {
024                public ActionType type;
025                public String responseReason;
026                public FactionAPI faction;
027                
028                public SectorEntityToken actor;
029                public SectorEntityToken target;
030                public float responseFraction;
031                public float responseDuration;
032                public String travelText;
033                public String actionText;

035                public MilitaryResponseParams(ActionType type, String responseReason,
036                                                                          FactionAPI faction, SectorEntityToken target,
037                                                                          float responseFraction, float responseDuration) {
038                        this.type = type;
039                        this.responseReason = responseReason;
040                        this.faction = faction;
041                        this.target = target;
042                        this.responseFraction = responseFraction;
043                        this.responseDuration = responseDuration;
044                }
045                
046                
047        }

049        
050        protected IntervalUtil tracker = new IntervalUtil(0.05f, 0.15f);
051        protected MilitaryResponseParams params;
052        protected float elapsed;
053        
054        public MilitaryResponseScript(MilitaryResponseParams params) {
055                this.params = params;
056                addToResponseTotal();
057                initiateResponse();
058        }
059
060        public void advance(float amount) {
061                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
062                tracker.advance(days);
063                
064                elapsed += days;
065                
066                
067//              if (params != null) {
068//                      System.out.println("MRS: " + params.responseReason);
069//              } else {
070//                      System.out.println("NULL MRS params");
071//              }
072                
073                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
074                        initiateResponse();
075                }
076        }
077
078        
079        public void initiateResponse() {
080                if (params.target.getContainingLocation() == null) return;
081//              if (params.faction.getId().equals(Factions.PIRATES) && params.target.isInCurrentLocation()) {
082//                      System.out.println("wefwefwe");
083//              }
084                if (params.target.getContainingLocation().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.SYSTEM_SUSPEND_MILITARY_RESPONSE_SCRIPT)) {
085                        return;
086                }
087                List<CampaignFleetAPI> fleets = params.target.getContainingLocation().getFleets();
088                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : fleets) {
089                        seeIfFleetShouldRespond(fleet);
090                }
091        }
092
093        protected boolean isTemporarilyNotResponding(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
094                if (fleet.getBattle() != null) return true;
095                
096                if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.FLEET_BUSY)) return true;
097                FleetAssignmentDataAPI curr = fleet.getCurrentAssignment();
098                if (curr != null && curr.getAssignment() == FleetAssignment.STANDING_DOWN) return true;
099                
100                MemoryAPI memory = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
101                if (memory.getBoolean(MemFlags.FLEET_MILITARY_RESPONSE)) return true;
102                
103                return false;
104        }
105        
106        protected void seeIfFleetShouldRespond(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
107//              if (fleet.getContainingLocation() == Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation()) {
108//                      System.out.println("fwefwef");
109//              }
110                
111                if (!couldRespond(fleet)) return;
112                
113                if (isTemporarilyNotResponding(fleet)) return;
114                
115                List<CampaignFleetAPI> fleets = params.target.getContainingLocation().getFleets();
116                float potentialFP = 0;
117                float respondingFP = 0f;
118                
119                float closestDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
120                CampaignFleetAPI closestNonResponder = null;
121                
122                for (CampaignFleetAPI other : fleets) {
123                        if (!couldRespond(other)) continue;
124                        
125                        float fp = other.getFleetPoints();
126                        
127                        potentialFP += fp;
128                        boolean responding = isResponding(other);
129                        if (responding) {
130                                respondingFP += fp;
131                        }
132                        
133                        //if (other == fleet) continue;
134                        
135                        if (!responding && !isTemporarilyNotResponding(other)) {
136                                float distOther = Misc.getDistance(params.target, other);
137                                if (distOther < closestDist) {
138                                        closestDist = distOther;
139                                        closestNonResponder = other;
140                                }
141                        }
142                }
143                
144                float fraction = params.responseFraction / getResponseTotal();
145                
146                //float dist = Misc.getDistance(params.target, fleet);
147                if (potentialFP > 0 &&
148                                respondingFP / potentialFP < fraction &&
149                                closestNonResponder == fleet) {
150                        
151                        respond(fleet);
152                }
153        }
154        
155        protected void respond(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
156                unrespond(fleet);
157                
158//              if (fleet.getContainingLocation() != null && fleet.getContainingLocation().getName().startsWith("Corvus")) {
159//                      System.out.println("fwefwe");
160//              }
161                //fleet.getAssignmentsCopy().get(0)
162                Misc.setFlagWithReason(fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), 
163                                                                MemFlags.FLEET_MILITARY_RESPONSE, params.responseReason, true, (1.5f + (float) Math.random()) * 0.2f);
164                
165                fleet.addAssignmentAtStart(FleetAssignment.PATROL_SYSTEM, params.target, 3f, params.actionText, null);
166                FleetAssignmentDataAPI curr = fleet.getCurrentAssignment();
167                if (curr != null) {
168                        curr.setCustom(RESPONSE_ASSIGNMENT);
169                }
170                
171                float dist = Misc.getDistance(params.target, fleet);
172                if (dist > 2000f) {
173                        fleet.addAssignmentAtStart(FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION, params.target, 3f, params.travelText, null);
174                        //fleet.addAssignmentAtStart(FleetAssignment.DELIVER_CREW, params.target, 3f, params.travelText, null);
175                        curr = fleet.getCurrentAssignment();
176                        if (curr != null) {
177                                curr.setCustom(RESPONSE_ASSIGNMENT);
178                        }
179                }
180                
181                //Global.getSector().addPing(fleet, Pings.DANGER);
182        }
183        
184        protected void unrespond(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
185                Misc.setFlagWithReason(fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), 
186                                                           MemFlags.FLEET_MILITARY_RESPONSE, params.responseReason, false, 0f);
187                boolean firstOrbitPassive = true;
188                for (FleetAssignmentDataAPI curr : fleet.getAI().getAssignmentsCopy()) {
189                        if (RESPONSE_ASSIGNMENT.equals(curr.getCustom())) {
190                                fleet.getAI().removeAssignment(curr);
191                        } else if (curr.getAssignment() == FleetAssignment.ORBIT_PASSIVE && firstOrbitPassive) {
192                                // "preparing for patrol" or some such, very likely - don't want to go back to that
193                                // after the response is done
194                                fleet.getAI().removeAssignment(curr);
195                                firstOrbitPassive = false;
196                        }
197                }
198        }
199        
200        protected boolean isResponding(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
201                return Misc.flagHasReason(fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), MemFlags.FLEET_MILITARY_RESPONSE, params.responseReason);
202        }
203        
204        protected boolean couldRespond(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
205                if (fleet.getFaction() != params.faction) return false;
206                if (fleet.getAI() == null) return false;
207                if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) return false;
208                if (fleet.isStationMode()) return false;
209                
210                // don't check for this here as it would skew proportiions of what's assigned where if a fleet is busy for a bit
211                //if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.FLEET_BUSY)) return false;
212                
213                if (fleet.getAI() instanceof ModularFleetAIAPI) {
214                        ModularFleetAIAPI ai = (ModularFleetAIAPI) fleet.getAI();
215                        if (ai.getAssignmentModule().areAssignmentsFrozen()) return false;
216                }
217                
218                if (fleet.getCurrentAssignment() != null && 
219                                fleet.getCurrentAssignment().getAssignment() == FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION_AND_DESPAWN) {
220                        return false;
221                }
222                
223                MemoryAPI memory = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
224                
225                boolean patrol = memory.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_FLEET);
226                boolean warFleet = memory.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_WAR_FLEET);
227                boolean pirate = memory.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PIRATE);
228                boolean noMilitary = memory.getBoolean(MemFlags.FLEET_NO_MILITARY_RESPONSE);
229                if (!(patrol || warFleet || pirate) || noMilitary) return false;
230                
231                return true;
232        }
233        
234        protected String getResponseTotalKey() {
235                return "$mrs_" + params.responseReason;
236        }
237        
238        protected void addToResponseTotal() {
239                MemoryAPI memory = params.faction.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
240                String key = getResponseTotalKey();
241                
242                float curr = memory.getFloat(key);
243                memory.set(key, curr + params.responseFraction, 60f);
244        }
245        
246        protected void removeFromResponseTotal() {
247                MemoryAPI memory = params.faction.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
248                String key = getResponseTotalKey();
249                
250                float curr = memory.getFloat(key);
251                if (curr > params.responseFraction) {
252                        memory.set(key, Math.max(0, curr - params.responseFraction), 60f);
253                } else {
254                        memory.unset(key);
255                }
256        }
257        
258        protected float getResponseTotal() {
259                MemoryAPI memory = params.faction.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
260                String key = getResponseTotalKey();
261                
262                float curr = memory.getFloat(key);
263                if (curr < params.responseFraction) curr = params.responseFraction;
264                if (curr < 1) curr = 1;
265                return curr;
266        }
267        
268        public void forceDone() {
269                if (params != null) {
270                        elapsed = params.responseDuration;
271                }
272        }
273        
274        public boolean isDone() {
275                if (params == null || elapsed >= params.responseDuration) {
276                        removeFromResponseTotal();
277                        params = null;
278                        return true;
279                }
280                return false;
281        }
282
283        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
284                return false;
285        }
